1	"""Replayable commit checkpoints for offline coordination.
2	
3	A checkpoint names an ``id``, the two 64-char lowercase hex digests of the
4	state and audit bytes it binds, and the ``stage`` the commit has reached.
5	Stages advance in the fixed order::
6	
7	    prepared -> state -> audit -> committed
8	
9	Checkpoints are kept in an index stored as UTF-8 compact JSON::
10	
11	    {"items":[{"audit":...,"id":...,"stage":...,"state":...},...],"version":1}\\n
12	
13	The top-level keys are fixed in the order ``items`` then ``version`` and
14	``version`` is always the integer 1.  ``items`` is an array of records
15	sorted ascending by ``id`` (ids are unique); each record carries the str
16	keys ``audit``, ``id``, ``stage`` and ``state`` in that order.  Non-ASCII
17	characters are preserved unescaped and the file ends with exactly one
18	``\\n``.
19	
20	A missing index file stands for an empty index.  An existing file is
21	corrupt unless it is one compact UTF-8 JSON encoding of a valid index:
22	no stray whitespace or non-canonical escapes and exactly one trailing
23	``\\n``.  The object *key order* carries no meaning, however, so an
24	otherwise identical compact encoding with the top-level or record keys
25	permuted is accepted as equivalent; files written by this module always
26	use the canonical key order described above.
27	
28	A brand-new id may only be recorded at the ``prepared`` stage.  Replaying
29	the same id with identical digests at the same stage is idempotent and
30	leaves the file bytes untouched; the stage may then advance one step at a
31	time, each advance replacing the file atomically.  Changed digests, a
32	stage regression or a skipped stage are rejected and never touch the file.
33	
34	:func:`resume` drives a single recovery step.  Its request carries only
35	the ``id``, ``state`` and ``audit`` digests and ``observed`` names the
36	stage the caller believes it has reached (``None`` for a fresh resume).
37	A new id is only accepted with ``observed=None`` and starts at
38	``prepared``.  For an existing id with identical digests, ``observed``
39	of ``None`` or the current stage only queries the index (leaving the
40	file bytes untouched), while the adjacent next stage advances it once;
41	a regression, a skipped stage or an illegal value is rejected without
42	touching the file.  The return value names the next action for the
43	processed stage: ``persist_state`` after ``prepared``,
44	``append_audit`` after ``state``, ``bind_receipt`` after ``audit`` and
45	``done`` after ``committed``.
46	
47	:func:`commit` drives a whole commit to completion.  Its ``paths`` map
48	names the ``checkpoint``, ``state``, ``audit`` and ``receipt`` files and
49	its request carries the ``id``, the full merge ``state`` and one audit
50	``event``.  The state digest is the SHA-256 of the canonical state bytes
51	storage writes; the audit digest is the hash of the one appended audit
52	record.  A first commit persists the state, appends exactly one event,
53	binds a receipt for the id and both digests, and advances the checkpoint
54	through the stages in order.  Replaying the same call -- after an
55	interruption or once committed -- deterministically resumes at the
56	recorded stage and performs every remaining side effect at most once,
57	returning the same ``audit``, ``id``, ``stage`` (``committed``) and
58	``state`` dict.  A digest conflict, or a checkpoint stage whose
59	artifacts do not match it, raises :class:`ValueError` and leaves the
60	files unchanged.
61	
62	:func:`inspect` is a strictly read-only counterpart taking only the
63	``paths`` map.  A missing checkpoint index yields an empty list; every
64	existing checkpoint is reported with its ``audit``, ``id``, ``stage``
65	and ``state`` values plus a ``status`` of ``recoverable``,
66	``committed`` or ``conflict`` derived from the state bytes, the audit
67	chain and any bound receipt.  Neither :func:`inspect` nor
68	:func:`commit` ever treats an existing-but-unreadable state as a mere
69	conflict: when at least one of the main and backup state files exists
70	but neither holds a valid state, :class:`CorruptStateError` propagates.
71	"""
72	
73	from __future__ import annotations
74	
75	import hashlib
76	import json
77	import os
78	import re
79	from typing import Any
80	
81	from . import audit as _audit
82	from . import receipt as _receipt
83	from . import storage as _storage
84	
85	AUDIT = "audit"
86	ID = "id"
87	STAGE = "stage"
88	STATE = "state"
89	STATUS = "status"
90	
91	ITEMS = "items"
92	VERSION = "version"
93	
94	PREPARED = "prepared"
95	STAGE_STATE = "state"
96	STAGE_AUDIT = "audit"
97	COMMITTED = "committed"
98	
99	_REQUEST_KEYS = (ID, STATE, AUDIT, STAGE)
100	_RESUME_KEYS = (ID, STATE, AUDIT)
101	_COMMIT_KEYS = (ID, STATE, "event")
102	_PATH_KEYS = ("checkpoint", STATE, AUDIT, "receipt")
103	_RECORD_KEYS = (AUDIT, ID, STAGE, STATE)
104	_INDEX_KEYS = (ITEMS, VERSION)
105	_INDEX_VERSION = 1
106	
107	_EVENT = "event"
108	_CHECKPOINT = "checkpoint"
109	_RECEIPT = "receipt"
110	
111	_STAGES = (PREPARED, STAGE_STATE, STAGE_AUDIT, COMMITTED)
112	_STAGE_RANK = {stage: rank for rank, stage in enumerate(_STAGES)}
113	
114	# Statuses reported by inspect for a checkpoint against its artifacts.
115	RECOVERABLE = "recoverable"
116	CONFLICT = "conflict"
117	
118	# Action performed once the checkpoint for a stage has been durably
119	# recorded: persist state after prepared, append the audit entry after
120	# state, bind the receipt after audit, and nothing after committed.
121	_NEXT_ACTIONS = {
122	    PREPARED: "persist_state",
123	    STAGE_STATE: "append_audit",
124	    STAGE_AUDIT: "bind_receipt",
125	    COMMITTED: "done",
126	}
127	
128	_ID_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}\Z")
129	_DIGEST_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
130	
131	
132	class CorruptTransactionError(ValueError):
133	    """The checkpoint index exists but its bytes are not a valid index."""
134	
135	
136	def _is_digest(value: Any) -> bool:
137	    return isinstance(value, str) and _DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(value) is not None
138	
139	
140	def _validated_request(request: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
141	    """Validate one checkpoint request and return a fresh dict in record order."""
142	    if not isinstance(request, dict):
143	        raise TypeError("request must be a dict")
144	    if set(request.keys()) != set(_REQUEST_KEYS):
145	        raise ValueError(
146	            "request must contain exactly the keys 'id', 'state', 'audit' "
147	            "and 'stage'"
148	        )
149	    for key in _REQUEST_KEYS:
150	        if not isinstance(request[key], str):
151	            raise TypeError(f"request {key} must be a str")
152	    checkpoint_id = request[ID]
153	    if _ID_RE.fullmatch(checkpoint_id) is None:
154	        raise ValueError("request id must match [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}")
155	    if not _is_digest(request[STATE]):
156	        raise ValueError("request state must be 64 lowercase hex characters")
157	    if not _is_digest(request[AUDIT]):
158	        raise ValueError("request audit must be 64 lowercase hex characters")
159	    stage = request[STAGE]
160	    if stage not in _STAGE_RANK:
161	        raise ValueError(
162	            "request stage must be one of 'prepared', 'state', 'audit' or "
163	            "'committed'"
164	        )
165	    return {
166	        AUDIT: request[AUDIT],
167	        ID: checkpoint_id,
168	        STAGE: stage,
169	        STATE: request[STATE],
170	    }
171	
172	
173	def _validated_resume_request(request: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
174	    """Validate one resume request and return a fresh dict in record order."""
175	    if not isinstance(request, dict):
176	        raise TypeError("request must be a dict")
177	    if set(request.keys()) != set(_RESUME_KEYS):
178	        raise ValueError(
179	            "request must contain exactly the keys 'id', 'state' and 'audit'"
180	        )
181	    for key in _RESUME_KEYS:
182	        if not isinstance(request[key], str):
183	            raise TypeError(f"request {key} must be a str")
184	    checkpoint_id = request[ID]
185	    if _ID_RE.fullmatch(checkpoint_id) is None:
186	        raise ValueError("request id must match [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}")
187	    if not _is_digest(request[STATE]):
188	        raise ValueError("request state must be 64 lowercase hex characters")
189	    if not _is_digest(request[AUDIT]):
190	        raise ValueError("request audit must be 64 lowercase hex characters")
191	    return {
192	        AUDIT: request[AUDIT],
193	        ID: checkpoint_id,
194	        STATE: request[STATE],
195	    }
196	
197	
198	def _serialize_index(records: list[dict[str, str]]) -> bytes:
199	    ordered = [
200	        {AUDIT: record[AUDIT], ID: record[ID], STAGE: record[STAGE],
201	         STATE: record[STATE]}
202	        for record in records
203	    ]
204	    index = {ITEMS: ordered, VERSION: _INDEX_VERSION}
205	    text = json.dumps(index, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
206	    return text.encode("utf-8")
207	
208	
209	def _parse_index(raw: bytes) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
210	    """Validate every byte of a checkpoint index and return its records.
211	
212	    Raises :class:`CorruptTransactionError` for any UTF-8/JSON failure,
213	    non-canonical byte encoding, wrong key set, bad version, duplicate or
214	    unsorted ids, or a field that is not a well-formed str.  The order of
215	    object keys does not matter: a compact encoding whose only difference
216	    from the canonical form is key permutation is an equivalent index.
217	    """
218	    if raw == b"":
219	        raise CorruptTransactionError("checkpoint index is empty")
220	    try:
221	        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
222	    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
223	        raise CorruptTransactionError("checkpoint index is not valid UTF-8") from exc
224	    try:
225	        data = json.loads(text)
226	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
227	        raise CorruptTransactionError("checkpoint index is not valid JSON") from exc
228	
229	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
230	        raise CorruptTransactionError("checkpoint index must be a JSON object")
231	    if set(data.keys()) != set(_INDEX_KEYS):
232	        raise CorruptTransactionError(
233	            "checkpoint index must contain exactly the keys 'items' and 'version'"
234	        )
235	    version = data[VERSION]
236	    # bool is a subclass of int; the version must be a genuine integer.
237	    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int) or version != 1:
238	        raise CorruptTransactionError("checkpoint index version must be the integer 1")
239	    raw_items = data[ITEMS]
240	    if not isinstance(raw_items, list):
241	        raise CorruptTransactionError("checkpoint index items must be an array")
242	
243	    records: list[dict[str, str]] = []
244	    for position, item in enumerate(raw_items):
245	        where = f"checkpoint index item {position}"
246	        if not isinstance(item, dict):
247	            raise CorruptTransactionError(f"{where} must be a JSON object")
248	        if set(item.keys()) != set(_RECORD_KEYS):
249	            raise CorruptTransactionError(
250	                f"{where} must contain exactly the keys 'audit', 'id', 'stage' "
251	                "and 'state'"
252	            )
253	        audit_digest = item[AUDIT]
254	        record_id = item[ID]
255	        stage = item[STAGE]
256	        state_digest = item[STATE]
257	        if not isinstance(record_id, str) or _ID_RE.fullmatch(record_id) is None:
258	            raise CorruptTransactionError(f"{where} has an invalid id")
259	        if not isinstance(stage, str) or stage not in _STAGE_RANK:
260	            raise CorruptTransactionError(f"{where} has an invalid stage")
261	        if not isinstance(state_digest, str) or not _is_digest(state_digest):
262	            raise CorruptTransactionError(
263	                f"{where} state must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
264	            )
265	        if not isinstance(audit_digest, str) or not _is_digest(audit_digest):
266	            raise CorruptTransactionError(
267	                f"{where} audit must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
268	            )
269	        records.append(
270	            {AUDIT: audit_digest, ID: record_id, STAGE: stage, STATE: state_digest}
271	        )
272	
273	    ids = [record[ID] for record in records]
274	    if any(left >= right for left, right in zip(ids, ids[1:])):
275	        raise CorruptTransactionError(
276	            "checkpoint index ids must be unique and sorted ascending"
277	        )
278	
279	    # Reject stray whitespace, non-canonical escapes, duplicate keys and
280	    # any encoding that is not a single compact form of the validated
281	    # structure.  Re-serialising the parsed object while preserving its
282	    # parsed key order tolerates permuted object keys (a semantically
283	    # equivalent compact index) while still rejecting every other
284	    # byte-level deviation; writes always use the canonical key order of
285	    # _serialize_index.
286	    if not raw.endswith(b"\n") or raw.endswith(b"\n\n"):
287	        raise CorruptTransactionError(
288	            "checkpoint index must end with exactly one newline"
289	        )
290	    compact = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
291	    if compact != text[:-1]:
292	        raise CorruptTransactionError("checkpoint index is not canonically encoded")
293	    return records
294	
295	
296	def _read_index(path: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
297	    try:
298	        with open(path, "rb") as handle:
299	            raw = handle.read()
300	    except FileNotFoundError:
301	        return []
302	    return _parse_index(raw)
303	
304	
305	def _atomic_write(path: str, payload: bytes) -> None:
306	    tmp_path = path + ".tmp"
307	    with open(tmp_path, "wb") as handle:
308	        handle.write(payload)
309	        handle.flush()
310	        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
311	    try:
312	        os.replace(tmp_path, path)
313	    except BaseException:
314	        try:
315	            os.unlink(tmp_path)
316	        except OSError:
317	            pass
318	        raise
319	    fd = os.open(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), os.O_RDONLY)
320	    try:
321	        os.fsync(fd)
322	    finally:
323	        os.close(fd)
324	
325	
326	def _apply(
327	    path: str, records: list[dict[str, str]], record: dict[str, str]
328	) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
329	    """Apply ``record`` to ``records`` and return the resulting record list."""
330	    for position, existing in enumerate(records):
331	        if existing[ID] != record[ID]:
332	            continue
333	        if (
334	            existing[STATE] != record[STATE]
335	            or existing[AUDIT] != record[AUDIT]
336	        ):
337	            raise ValueError(
338	                f"checkpoint id {record[ID]!r} is already bound to different "
339	                "state or audit digests"
340	            )
341	        old_rank = _STAGE_RANK[existing[STAGE]]
342	        new_rank = _STAGE_RANK[record[STAGE]]
343	        if new_rank == old_rank:
344	            # Idempotent replay: no filesystem change.
345	            return records
346	        if new_rank < old_rank:
347	            raise ValueError(
348	                f"checkpoint id {record[ID]!r} cannot regress from stage "
349	                f"{existing[STAGE]!r} to {record[STAGE]!r}"
350	            )
351	        if new_rank > old_rank + 1:
352	            raise ValueError(
353	                f"checkpoint id {record[ID]!r} cannot skip from stage "
354	                f"{existing[STAGE]!r} to {record[STAGE]!r}"
355	            )
356	        updated = list(records)
357	        updated[position] = record
358	        _atomic_write(path, _serialize_index(updated))
359	        return updated
360	
361	    if record[STAGE] != PREPARED:
362	        raise ValueError("a new checkpoint id must start at the 'prepared' stage")
363	    updated = sorted(records + [record], key=lambda entry: entry[ID])
364	    _atomic_write(path, _serialize_index(updated))
365	    return updated
366	
367	
368	def checkpoint(
369	    path: str, request: dict[str, str] | None = None
370	) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
371	    """Record or query a replayable commit checkpoint at ``path``.
372	
373	    With ``request=None`` this is a pure query returning every checkpoint.
374	    Otherwise ``request`` must contain exactly the str keys ``id``,
375	    ``state``, ``audit`` and ``stage``: ``id`` matches
376	    ``[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}``, ``state`` and ``audit`` are 64 lowercase hex
377	    characters, and ``stage`` is one of ``prepared``, ``state``, ``audit``
378	    or ``committed``.
379	
380	    A new id is inserted at ``prepared``; an existing id with identical
381	    digests replays idempotently at the same stage or advances one adjacent
382	    stage.  Changed digests, a stage regression or a skipped stage raise
383	    :class:`ValueError` and leave the file unchanged.  In every case a
384	    brand-new list sorted ascending by ``id`` is returned, each element a
385	    fresh dict with the key order ``audit``, ``id``, ``stage``, ``state``.
386	
387	    Type violations raise :class:`TypeError`; a bad key set, field format
388	    or stage migration raises :class:`ValueError`; a corrupt index raises
389	    :class:`CorruptTransactionError`; other filesystem errors propagate as
390	    :class:`OSError`.
391	    """
392	    if not isinstance(path, str):
393	        raise TypeError("path must be a str")
394	
395	    record = _validated_request(request) if request is not None else None
396	    records = _read_index(path)
397	    if record is not None:
398	        records = _apply(path, records, record)
399	
400	    return [
401	        {
402	            AUDIT: record[AUDIT],
403	            ID: record[ID],
404	            STAGE: record[STAGE],
405	            STATE: record[STATE],
406	        }
407	        for record in records
408	    ]

411	def resume(
412	    path: str, request: dict[str, str], observed: str | None = None
413	) -> str:
414	    """Recover one commit step at ``path`` and return the next action.
415	
416	    ``request`` must contain exactly the str keys ``id``, ``state`` and
417	    ``audit`` in the same format as the matching :func:`checkpoint`
418	    fields.  ``observed`` must be ``None`` or one of the stages
419	    ``prepared``, ``state``, ``audit`` or ``committed``; it names the
420	    stage the caller has observed for the id.
421	
422	    A new id is only accepted with ``observed=None`` and is recorded at
423	    the ``prepared`` stage.  An existing id must be bound to the same
424	    ``state`` and ``audit`` digests; with ``observed=None`` or the
425	    current stage the call is a pure query and leaves the file bytes
426	    untouched, while ``observed`` naming the adjacent next stage
427	    advances the checkpoint exactly once.  A stage regression, a skipped
428	    stage or an illegal ``observed`` value raise :class:`ValueError` and
429	    leave the file unchanged.
430	
431	    The return value is the next action for the processed stage:
432	    ``persist_state`` for ``prepared``, ``append_audit`` for ``state``,
433	    ``bind_receipt`` for ``audit`` and ``done`` for ``committed``.
434	
435	    A non-str ``observed`` other than ``None`` raises :class:`TypeError`;
436	    the remaining type and value rules, :class:`CorruptTransactionError`
437	    and :class:`OSError` propagation match :func:`checkpoint`.
438	    """
439	    if not isinstance(path, str):
440	        raise TypeError("path must be a str")
441	
442	    requested = _validated_resume_request(request)
443	    if observed is not None:
444	        if not isinstance(observed, str):
445	            raise TypeError(
446	                "observed must be None or one of 'prepared', 'state', "
447	                "'audit' or 'committed'"
448	            )
449	        if observed not in _STAGE_RANK:
450	            raise ValueError(
451	                "observed must be None or one of 'prepared', 'state', "
452	                "'audit' or 'committed'"
453	            )
454	
455	    records = _read_index(path)
456	    existing = next(
457	        (record for record in records if record[ID] == requested[ID]), None
458	    )
459	
460	    if existing is None:
461	        if observed is not None:
462	            raise ValueError(
463	                f"checkpoint id {requested[ID]!r} is new and may only be "
464	                "resumed with observed=None"
465	            )
466	        record = {
467	            AUDIT: requested[AUDIT],
468	            ID: requested[ID],
469	            STAGE: PREPARED,
470	            STATE: requested[STATE],
471	        }
472	        _apply(path, records, record)
473	        return _NEXT_ACTIONS[PREPARED]
474	
475	    if (
476	        existing[STATE] != requested[STATE]
477	        or existing[AUDIT] != requested[AUDIT]
478	    ):
479	        raise ValueError(
480	            f"checkpoint id {requested[ID]!r} is already bound to different "
481	            "state or audit digests"
482	        )
483	
484	    current_stage = existing[STAGE]
485	    if observed is None or observed == current_stage:
486	        # Pure query: no filesystem change.
487	        processed_stage = current_stage
488	    else:
489	        current_rank = _STAGE_RANK[current_stage]
490	        observed_rank = _STAGE_RANK[observed]
491	        if observed_rank < current_rank:
492	            raise ValueError(
493	                f"checkpoint id {requested[ID]!r} cannot regress from stage "
494	                f"{current_stage!r} to {observed!r}"
495	            )
496	        if observed_rank > current_rank + 1:
497	            raise ValueError(
498	                f"checkpoint id {requested[ID]!r} cannot skip from stage "
499	                f"{current_stage!r} to {observed!r}"
500	            )
501	        record = {
502	            AUDIT: requested[AUDIT],
503	            ID: requested[ID],
504	            STAGE: observed,
505	            STATE: requested[STATE],
506	        }
507	        _apply(path, records, record)
508	        processed_stage = observed
509	
510	    return _NEXT_ACTIONS[processed_stage]
511

520	def _validated_paths(paths: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
521	    """Validate the ``checkpoint``/``state``/``audit``/``receipt`` path map."""
522	    if not isinstance(paths, dict):
523	        raise TypeError("paths must be a dict")
524	    if set(paths.keys()) != set(_PATH_KEYS):
525	        raise ValueError(
526	            "paths must contain exactly the keys 'checkpoint', 'state', "
527	            "'audit' and 'receipt'"
528	        )
529	    for key in _PATH_KEYS:
530	        if not isinstance(paths[key], str):
531	            raise TypeError(f"paths {key} must be a str")
532	    return {key: paths[key] for key in _PATH_KEYS}

535	def _validated_commit_inputs(
536	    paths: Any, request: Any
537	) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str, dict[str, Any], dict[str, str], bytes]:
538	    """Validate ``paths`` and a commit ``request`` before any file access.
539	
540	    Returns the path map, id, the caller's state, a fresh validated event
541	    dict and the canonical state bytes.  The state is checked against the
542	    merge state contract and the event against the audit event contract,
543	    so their type/value errors propagate unchanged in kind.
544	    """
545	    path_map = _validated_paths(paths)
546	    if not isinstance(request, dict):
547	        raise TypeError("request must be a dict")
548	    if set(request.keys()) != set(_COMMIT_KEYS):
549	        raise ValueError(
550	            "request must contain exactly the keys 'id', 'state' and 'event'"
551	        )
552	    checkpoint_id = request[ID]
553	    if not isinstance(checkpoint_id, str):
554	        raise TypeError("request id must be a str")
555	    if _ID_RE.fullmatch(checkpoint_id) is None:
556	        raise ValueError("request id must match [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}")
557	
558	    payload = _state_payload(request[STATE])
559	    event = _audit._validated_event(request[_EVENT])
560	
561	    return path_map, checkpoint_id, request[STATE], event, payload

564	def _planned_audit_digest(
565	    audit_records: list[dict[str, Any]], event: dict[str, str]
566	) -> str:
567	    """Hash the audit record the next :func:`audit.append` would write.
568	
569	    Deterministic from the log's current tail: its seq is one past the
570	    last record and its prev is the last record's hash (or the zero hash
571	    for an empty log).
572	    """
573	    seq = len(audit_records) + 1
574	    prev = audit_records[-1][_audit.HASH] if audit_records else _audit._ZERO_HASH
575	    without_hash = {
576	        _audit.DETAIL: event[_audit.DETAIL],
577	        _audit.KIND: event[_audit.KIND],
578	        _audit.PREV: prev,
579	        _audit.SEQ: seq,
580	        _audit.SOURCE: event[_audit.SOURCE],
581	    }
582	    return _audit._record_hash(without_hash)
583

585	def _event_matches(record: dict[str, Any], event: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
586	    return (
587	        record[_audit.SOURCE] == event[_audit.SOURCE]
588	        and record[_audit.KIND] == event[_audit.KIND]
589	        and record[_audit.DETAIL] == event[_audit.DETAIL]
590	    )

615	    missing or when its bytes do not decode to a valid state.  No
616	    exception other than a non-:class:`FileNotFoundError`

645	    """Raise unless the state is absent or a valid state survives.
646	
647	    Mirrors :func:`storage.load_state`: when at least one of the main and
648	    backup files exists but neither holds a valid state,
649	    :class:`CorruptStateError` propagates unchanged; when neither file

659	def _inspect_status(
660	    stage: str,
661	    state_matches: bool,
662	    audit_ok: bool,
663	    receipt: dict[str, str] | None,
664	    state_digest: str,
665	    audit_digest: str,
666	) -> str:
667	    """Classify one checkpoint from its stage and the S/A/R0/R1 facts.
668	
669	    ``S`` is ``state_matches`` (the main state file's canonical bytes hash
670	    to the state digest), ``A`` is ``audit_ok`` (a valid audit chain
671	    carries the audit digest), ``R0`` means no receipt is bound under the
672	    id and ``R1`` means that receipt binds exactly both digests.
673	    ``prepared`` with ``not A and R0``, ``state`` with ``S and R0`` and
674	    ``audit`` with ``S and A and (R0 or R1)`` are recoverable;
675	    ``committed`` with ``S and A and R1`` is committed; everything else
676	    is a conflict.
677	    """
678	    r0 = receipt is None
679	    r1 = (
680	        receipt is not None
681	        and receipt[STATE] == state_digest
682	        and receipt[AUDIT] == audit_digest
683	    )
684	    if stage == PREPARED:
685	        if not audit_ok and r0:
686	            return RECOVERABLE
687	    elif stage == STAGE_STATE:
688	        if state_matches and r0:
689	            return RECOVERABLE
690	    elif stage == STAGE_AUDIT:
691	        if state_matches and audit_ok and (r0 or r1):
692	            return RECOVERABLE
693	    else:  # COMMITTED
694	        if state_matches and audit_ok and r1:
695	            return COMMITTED
696	    return CONFLICT

699	def inspect(paths: dict[str, str]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
700	    """Read-only inspection of every checkpoint against its bound artifacts.
701	
702	    ``paths`` must contain exactly the str keys ``checkpoint``, ``state``,
703	    ``audit`` and ``receipt``, naming the checkpoint index, the main state
704	    file (its ``path + ".bak"`` backup is consulted for corruption
705	    detection, exactly as :func:`storage.load_state` does), the audit log
706	    and the receipt index.
707	
708	    A missing checkpoint index yields ``[]`` (no other artifact is read in
709	    that case).  Otherwise one fresh dict per checkpoint is returned sorted
710	    ascending by ``id`` with the fixed key order ``audit``, ``id``,
711	    ``stage``, ``state``, ``status``; the first four values are copied from
712	    the checkpoint and ``status`` is one of ``recoverable``, ``committed``
713	    or ``conflict``.
714	
715	    Let ``S`` mean the main state file holds a complete valid state whose
716	    canonical bytes hash to the state digest, ``A`` mean a valid audit
717	    chain contains a record whose hash is the audit digest, ``R0`` mean no
718	    receipt is bound under the id and ``R1`` mean that receipt binds
719	    exactly both digests.  A ``prepared`` checkpoint with ``not A and R0``,
720	    a ``state`` checkpoint with ``S and R0`` and an ``audit`` checkpoint
721	    with ``S and A and (R0 or R1)`` are ``recoverable``; a ``committed``
722	    checkpoint with ``S and A and R1`` is ``committed``; every other
723	    combination is ``conflict``.
724	
725	    No file is created or modified.  Type violations raise
726	    :class:`TypeError` and a bad path key set raises :class:`ValueError`;
727	    when at least one of the state main/backup files exists but neither
728	    holds a valid state, :class:`CorruptStateError` propagates unchanged,
729	    as do :class:`CorruptAuditError`, :class:`CorruptReceiptError`,
730	    :class:`CorruptTransactionError` and :class:`OSError`.
731	    """
732	    path_map = _validated_paths(paths)
733	
734	    records = _read_index(path_map[_CHECKPOINT])
735	    if not records:
736	        return []
737	
738	    audit_records = _audit._read_all_records(path_map[AUDIT])
739	    receipts_by_id = {
740	        receipt[ID]: receipt for receipt in _receipt._read_index(path_map[_RECEIPT])
741	    }
742	    main_state_bytes = _main_state_canonical_bytes(path_map[STATE])
743	    _assert_state_loadable(path_map[STATE])
744	
745	    audit_hashes = {record[_audit.HASH] for record in audit_records}
746	
747	    items: list[dict[str, str]] = []
748	    for record in records:
749	        state_digest = record[STATE]
750	        audit_digest = record[AUDIT]
751	        state_matches = (
752	            main_state_bytes is not None
753	            and hashlib.sha256(main_state_bytes).hexdigest() == state_digest
754	        )
755	        audit_ok = audit_digest in audit_hashes
756	        receipt = receipts_by_id.get(record[ID])
757	        status = _inspect_status(
758	            record[STAGE], state_matches, audit_ok, receipt,
759	            state_digest, audit_digest,
760	        )
761	        items.append(
762	            {
763	                AUDIT: audit_digest,
764	                ID: record[ID],
765	                STAGE: record[STAGE],
766	                STATE: state_digest,
767	                STATUS: status,
768	            }
769	        )
770	    return items
771

773	def commit(paths: dict[str, str], request: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
774	    """Run one replayable commit across storage, audit, receipt and checkpoint.
775	
776	    ``paths`` must contain exactly the str keys ``checkpoint``, ``state``,
777	    ``audit`` and ``receipt``.  ``request`` must contain exactly the keys
778	    ``id`` (same format as :func:`checkpoint`), ``state`` (a state obeying
779	    the :mod:`~offline_coordination.merge` state contract) and ``event``
780	    (an event obeying the :mod:`~offline_coordination.audit` event
781	    contract).
782	
783	    The state digest is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the complete
784	    canonical state bytes (including the trailing ``\\n``) that
785	    :mod:`~offline_coordination.storage` persists; the audit digest is
786	    the hash of the single audit record appended for this commit.  A
787	    first commit saves the state, appends exactly one audit event, binds
788	    a receipt carrying the id and both digests, and advances the
789	    checkpoint through ``prepared``, ``state``, ``audit`` and
790	    ``committed`` in that order.
791	
792	    Replaying the same arguments -- or re-entering after an interruption
793	    -- resumes at the recorded stage and performs each remaining side
794	    effect at most once, so the result is identical and no effect is
795	    duplicated.  Every artifact is reconciled against the checkpoint
796	    stage before any file is touched: a digest conflict, or a stage
797	    whose state file, audit record or receipt is missing, extra or
798	    mismatched, raises :class:`ValueError` and leaves the files
799	    unchanged.
800	
801	    On success a brand-new dict is returned with the key order
802	    ``audit``, ``id``, ``stage``, ``state`` and ``stage`` equal to
803	    ``committed``.  Type violations raise :class:`TypeError`; bad key
804	    sets, formats, state/event values, digest conflicts and stage/
805	    artifact mismatches raise :class:`ValueError`;
806	    :class:`CorruptStateError`, :class:`CorruptAuditError`,
807	    :class:`CorruptReceiptError`, :class:`CorruptTransactionError` and
808	    :class:`OSError` propagate unchanged.
809	    """
810	    (
811	        path_map,
812	        checkpoint_id,
813	        state,
814	        event,
815	        payload,
816	    ) = _validated_commit_inputs(paths, request)
817	    checkpoint_path = path_map[_CHECKPOINT]
818	    state_path = path_map[STATE]
819	    audit_path = path_map[AUDIT]
820	    receipt_path = path_map[_RECEIPT]
821	
822	    state_digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
823	
824	    # Read every artifact up front.  All reconciliation below happens
825	    # before any mutation, so a rejected commit changes nothing.
826	    audit_records = _audit._read_all_records(audit_path)
827	    planned_audit_digest = _planned_audit_digest(audit_records, event)
828	    bound_receipt = _receipt.get(receipt_path, checkpoint_id)
829	    records = _read_index(checkpoint_path)
830	    existing = next(
831	        (record for record in records if record[ID] == checkpoint_id), None
832	    )
833	    state_on_disk = _read_state_bytes(state_path)
834	    # When a state file exists but neither the main file nor the backup
835	    # holds a valid state the situation is unrecoverable, not a digest
836	    # conflict: CorruptStateError propagates before any reconciliation.
837	    _assert_state_loadable(state_path)
838	
839	    need_save = False
840	    need_append = False
841	    need_receipt = False
842	
843	    if existing is None:
844	        # An id absent from the checkpoint index cannot have produced any
845	        # artifact of its own yet; a receipt bound under it is a conflict.
846	        if bound_receipt is not None:
847	            raise ValueError(
848	                f"receipt id {checkpoint_id!r} is already bound but no "
849	                "checkpoint exists for it"
850	            )
851	        audit_digest = planned_audit_digest
852	        stage = PREPARED
853	        # The state save is the first artifact effect; it is pending
854	        # unless the main file already holds the committed bytes.
855	        need_save = state_on_disk != payload
856	        need_append = True
857	        need_receipt = True
858	    else:
859	        if existing[STATE] != state_digest:
860	            raise ValueError(
861	                f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is already bound to a "
862	                "different state digest"
863	            )
864	        audit_digest = existing[AUDIT]
865	        stage = existing[STAGE]
866	        audit_record = next(
867	            (item for item in audit_records
868	             if item[_audit.HASH] == audit_digest),
869	            None,
870	        )
871	
872	        if stage == PREPARED:
873	            # The event has not been appended yet, so its record hash must
874	            # still be derivable from the current log tail.
875	            if audit_digest != planned_audit_digest:
876	                raise ValueError(
877	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is already bound to a "
878	                    "different audit digest"
879	                )
880	            if audit_record is not None:
881	                raise ValueError(
882	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is at stage 'prepared' "
883	                    "but its audit record is already present"
884	                )
885	            if bound_receipt is not None:
886	                raise ValueError(
887	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is at stage 'prepared' "
888	                    "but a receipt is already bound"
889	                )
890	            # The save is pending unless the main file already holds the
891	            # committed bytes; save_state itself rotates any prior state.
892	            need_save = state_on_disk != payload
893	            need_append = True
894	            need_receipt = True
895	        elif stage == STAGE_STATE:
896	            if state_on_disk != payload:
897	                raise ValueError(
898	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is past stage "
899	                    "'prepared' but its state file is missing or mismatched"
900	                )
901	            if bound_receipt is not None:
902	                raise ValueError(
903	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is at stage 'state' but "
904	                    "a receipt is already bound"
905	                )
906	            if audit_record is None:
907	                # The append may still be pending; the log tail must still
908	                # derive the bound record for this event.
909	                if audit_digest != planned_audit_digest:
910	                    raise ValueError(
911	                        f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is at stage 'state' "
912	                        "but its audit record is missing"
913	                    )
914	                need_append = True
915	            elif not _event_matches(audit_record, event):
916	                raise ValueError(
917	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} audit record does not "
918	                    "match its committed event"
919	                )
920	            need_receipt = True
921	        elif stage == STAGE_AUDIT:
922	            if state_on_disk != payload:
923	                raise ValueError(
924	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is past stage "
925	                    "'prepared' but its state file is missing or mismatched"
926	                )
927	            if audit_record is None:
928	                raise ValueError(
929	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is past stage 'state' "
930	                    "but its audit record is missing"
931	                )
932	            if not _event_matches(audit_record, event):
933	                raise ValueError(
934	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} audit record does not "
935	                    "match its committed event"
936	                )
937	            if bound_receipt is None:
938	                need_receipt = True
939	            elif (
940	                bound_receipt[STATE] != state_digest
941	                or bound_receipt[AUDIT] != audit_digest
942	            ):
943	                raise ValueError(
944	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} receipt is bound to "
945	                    "different state or audit digests"
946	                )
947	        else:  # COMMITTED
948	            if state_on_disk != payload:
949	                raise ValueError(
950	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is past stage "
951	                    "'prepared' but its state file is missing or mismatched"
952	                )
953	            if audit_record is None:
954	                raise ValueError(
955	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is past stage 'state' "
956	                    "but its audit record is missing"
957	                )
958	            if not _event_matches(audit_record, event):
959	                raise ValueError(
960	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} audit record does not "
961	                    "match its committed event"
962	                )
963	            if bound_receipt is None:
964	                raise ValueError(
965	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} is committed but its "
966	                    "receipt is missing"
967	                )
968	            if (
969	                bound_receipt[STATE] != state_digest
970	                or bound_receipt[AUDIT] != audit_digest
971	            ):
972	                raise ValueError(
973	                    f"checkpoint id {checkpoint_id!r} receipt is bound to "
974	                    "different state or audit digests"
975	                )
976	
977	    # Reconciliation succeeded; perform each remaining effect at most
978	    # once and advance the checkpoint after every durable step.
979	    if existing is None:
980	        records = _advance(
981	            checkpoint_path, records, checkpoint_id,
982	            state_digest, audit_digest, PREPARED,
983	        )
984	
985	    if stage == PREPARED:
